final_answer: Correctly identifies the cwd-relative db_path default as splitting Milcah's queue from the daemon's database with start_worker=False leaving nothing to drain it, and proposes the ground-truth fix of delegating the default to Hoglah's own config.
ground_truth: HoglahExtractorConfig defaults db_path to a cwd-relative path (data/hoglah/jobs.sqlite3). Milcah submits with start_worker=False, so an external worker must be draining the same database - but the installed worker drains ~/.hoglah/hoglah.db. Every specialist call therefore wrote into a private, cwd-relative queue that nothing was watching, and blocked until its timeout. The fix is to take the defaults from Hoglah's own config so the two cannot disagree, and honour HOGLAH_DB_PATH.
